jobsPage.title: Jobs
jobsPage.subtitle: Everything the app does in the background: pictures, videos, renders, subtitles. Here you can see what is running, what is waiting, and what failed.
jobsPage.runnerDown: Background work is not running inside the app. Restart the app; until then new jobs will only wait in the queue.

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.text: When you make a picture or a video, its job shows up here.

row.retryAsk: Run “{title}” again? Google may charge for it again.
row.unknownKind: This app version does not know this job type, so it cannot be run again.
row.interruptedHint: The app stopped while this job was running. It was not restarted by itself, so nothing is paid twice. Press “Run again” if you still need it.

services.title: Helper services
services.notResponding: The service is not responding. Check that all app containers are running in Docker.

load.title: How many jobs run at once
load.hint: Extra jobs wait in the queue. Fewer at once means fewer “too many requests” answers from Google on a new project.

upkeep.title: Upkeep
upkeep.backupNone: No database backup yet: the first one is made within a day.
upkeep.stuck: A job without progress for {n} minute is stopped. | A job without progress for {n} minutes is stopped.
upkeep.stuckOff: Jobs without progress are never stopped by the app.
upkeep.keep: Finished jobs are removed from this list after {n} day. | Finished jobs are removed from this list after {n} days.
upkeep.keepForever: Finished jobs stay in this list forever.
upkeep.where: Backups are in the backups folder inside the app data folder. Removing a job from the list does not delete its files or spend records.

settings.title: Jobs settings
settings.limitsHint: From 1 to 8 for each kind of work. On a new Google project keep pictures and video at 2 or less.
settings.stuckMinutes: Stop a job without progress after, minutes
settings.stuckHint: 0 — never stop. Long videos can take a while, so do not set this too low.
settings.keepDays: Remove finished jobs from the list after, days
settings.keepHint: 0 — keep forever. Files and spend records stay either way.
settings.backupDaily: Back up the database every day
settings.backupKeep: How many daily copies to keep
settings.backupHint: Older copies are deleted. Each copy is about the size of the database.
